steps.text: 2. The system shows the Contributor's tour list with status chips (Draft, AI review in progress, AI Warning, Pending review, Public, Rejected, Needs changes, Restricted access, Hidden). E1, E5.

exceptions.text: E1. No tours yet → "No tours yet" and a "Create tour" button.
E5. List load error → warning and a "Retry list" button.

steps.text: 3. The Contributor taps "Create tour". A1, A2, A3.
4. The system shows the form: name, description, city, tour type, original language, duration, cover image.
5. The Contributor enters the information and picks a cover image.
6. The system (Media) checks the real image format (magic bytes) and stores the image on Supabase Storage. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Invalid cover image format → 415 "Only JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF images are accepted"; over 8 MB → 413; storage error → 503.

steps.text: 7. The Contributor taps "Create & add stops". A4.
8. The system (Tour) validates the data and creates the tour in the Draft status. E2.

exceptions.text: E2. Missing name / original language, invalid language or tour type → 400 ("Please enter the tour name", "Please choose the original language", "Unsupported language: xx").

steps.text: 9. The system moves on to adding stops (UC#10).

exceptions.text: E4. The tour does not exist → 404; someone else's tour → 403.
E6. Publishing conditions not met → 422 with the list of missing items; status does not allow it → 409.

steps: A1. Edit a tour: open the tour, edit the information and save; an edited Public tour goes back to Draft and must be submitted for review again. E4.
A2. Delete the tour: the system asks for confirmation, then deletes the tour with its places, route and related translations. E4.
A3. Publish: the system shows a checklist (name, original language, at least 1 place, every place has a description); with moderation enabled, this button is "Submit for review" (UC#15). E6.
A4. "Save draft & exit": save the Draft tour and go back to the list.
